note.en: Authored offline isometric pixel-art city of Central, Hong Kong, baked from OpenStreetMap: about 1,400 buildings and building parts on their mapped footprints at their mapped heights, eight labelled landmarks, traffic, parks and the harbour, pan, zoom and quarter turns, day into night, and a deterministic 60-second film. Colours and textures are drawn by code, not photographs. Silent by design; no runtime model calls.
note.zh-CN: 原创离线等距像素城市，示例为从 OpenStreetMap 烘焙的香港中环：约 1400 栋建筑和建筑部件按地图轮廓与登记高度摆放，八个带标注的地标，车流、公园和海港，可平移、缩放、按四分之一圈旋转，从白天到夜晚，并有可确定重放的 60 秒影片。颜色和纹理由代码绘制，不是照片。设计上无声音，运行时不调用模型。
